channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-129869 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | SamWaf 1.0.128 through 1.3.25-beta.11 contains a request body inspection bypass vulnerability in WafEngine.ServeHTTP that skips bodies with chunked encoding or lengths of 2048 bytes or more. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send SQL injection, XSS, command injection, traversal or upload payloads chunked or padded, which reach the protected backend uninspected.

item.title: CVE-2026-129870 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitting crafted media values. Attackers can send dot-dot-slash sequences in the avatar or media content to POST /v1/user/avatar or POST /v1/post/comment, deleting server-writable files including configuration and data.

item.title: CVE-2026-129871 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Rocboss paopao-ce through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a payment bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain paid attachments by reading storage URLs from the GET /v1/post endpoint. Attackers can download the paid file directly from the unauthenticated LocalOSS /oss static route, whose signed URL expired parameter is never checked.

item.title: CVE-2026-129872 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/tasks/list. Attackers can use priority-* plans and the returned task count as a boolean oracle to recover a task creator's SHA-256 password hash and log in as that user, including the administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-129873 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | REBUILD 4.3.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to obtain a SYSTEM_USER token by requesting /commons/file-preview with an arbitrary src value. Attackers can read the leaked _csrfToken from the redirect Location header and send it as X-AuthToken to access the admin center and administrative APIs.

item.title: CVE-2026-129874 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | REBUILD 3.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to modify their own roleId through mass assignment in /app/entity/record-save and /app/entity/common-save. Attackers can submit their own User record with roleId set to the built-in administrator role, bypassing updatable=false restrictions to gain full administrator privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-129875 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | REBUILD 4.5.0 through 4.5.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to recover the administrator password hash by filtering User.password through the MCP QueryRecords tool. Attackers can send LK2 prefix-match filters to the /gw/mcp/sse gateway and use the returned total count as an oracle to extract the SHA-256 hash one character at a time, then log in as administrator.

item.title: CVE-2026-129876 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.8 | OfficeCLI 1.0.56 through 1.0.161 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the officecli watch preview that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped numbering w:color values. Attackers can craft a DOCX whose color closes the style element, then abuse the unauthenticated /api/batch endpoint to read local files and modify the watched document.

item.title: CVE-2026-129877 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve server secrets through the /api/v1/config/defaults endpoint. Attackers can send a GET request to obtain the operator's LLM provider API keys and GitHub or GitLab tokens, then abuse those services and accessible repositories.

item.title: CVE-2026-129878 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform SSRF. Attackers can create a project whose name contains a link attachment element and download the task PDF report to retrieve local files or internal network responses.

item.title: CVE-2026-129879 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated users to write arbitrary files by importing projects with crafted IDs. Attackers can set absolute or ../ project IDs via /api/v1/database/import, then upload ZIPs through /api/v1/scan/upload-zip following cloned symlinks to overwrite app/main.py for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-129880 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows registered users to leak server-wide GitLab or Gitea tokens via repository_url. Attackers can create a gitlab or gitea project pointing to a controlled host and request its branches to capture the operator's token and reach internal hosts.

item.title: CVE-2026-129881 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Weblate 2026.6 through 2026.11.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in ChangeManager.last_changes() that exposes workspaces the viewer cannot view by skipping Workspace.can_view() checks site-wide. Anonymous visitors on instances with REQUIRE_LOGIN disabled and only public projects can query /changes/, /api/changes/, or RSS/CSV feeds to obtain hidden workspace names, UUIDs, actions, and timestamps.

item.title: CVE-2026-129882 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Kiwi TCMS before 17.1 contains a hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability that allows remote attackers to forge signed data by using the publicly known Django SECRET_KEY in tcms/settings/common.py. Attackers can forge or tamper with signed cookie-based messages and django.core.signing payloads, weakening password-reset and session-authentication HMACs on deployments keeping the default.

item.title: CVE-2026-129883 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows remote attackers to send users to arbitrary sites by supplying an unvalidated redirectUri parameter on the /pay/[id] payment link page. Attackers can distribute payment links with a malicious redirectUri that PayPageWidget opens via window.open after payment without noopener, enabling phishing and reverse tabnabbing of the payment page.

item.title: CVE-2026-129884 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the fetchClientSecret Next.js server action that allows unauthenticated attackers to create Stripe checkout sessions for other teams. Attackers can invoke the action with a forged Team object containing a victim's stripeCustomerId to obtain Growth plan Checkout session client secrets with attacker-influenced return URLs.

item.title: CVE-2026-129885 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Unrolled Secure before 1.18.0 contains an SSLRedirect bypass vulnerability in Secure.isSSL() that trusts the client-supplied r.URL.Scheme to determine HTTPS transport. Attackers can send plaintext HTTP requests with an absolute-form https:// request-target to skip the HTTPS redirect and have application responses served unencrypted.

item.title: CVE-2026-129886 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in revalidatePathAction and revalidateCacheTagAction server actions in revalidate.ts. Unauthenticated attackers can use action identifiers exposed in the client bundle to send POST requests that purge cached pages and data, forcing repeated regeneration and degrading performance.

item.title: CVE-2026-129887 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | thirdweb Dashboard through commit 940b3745 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read non-public team metadata by requesting the team join page with any invite ID. Attackers who know a team slug can obtain the serialized Team object, exposing billing email, billing status, Stripe customer ID, verified domain and support identifiers.

item.title: CVE-2026-129888 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.6 | Cetmix Tower through 17.0.3.0.0 and 18.0 before 18.0.4.0.1 contains an improper SSH host key verification vulnerability in SSHConnection.connect() that falls back to Paramiko's AutoAddPolicy when no host key is pinned. On-path attackers using ARP or DNS spoofing can present their own host key during Skip Host Key or Get from Host connections to capture stored SSH passwords and tamper with commands and files.

item.title: CVE-2026-129940 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the unauthenticated GET /prime/redirect route that allows remote attackers to redirect users to external sites. Attackers can craft links with a 36-character id and arbitrary url parameter on the trusted Prime host to send victims to phishing sites.

item.title: CVE-2026-129941 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to register accounts via the createUser mutation on /prime/graphql. Because the isAuthenticated() guard has its check commented out and createAbility() hard-codes every role to admin, attackers can log in with full administrative control over content, users, webhooks and settings.

item.title: CVE-2026-129942 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to invoke privileged GraphQL mutations because the @Authorized() decorator is omitted. Attackers can call updateWebhook, createRelease, unpublishDocument and updateUser at /prime/graphql to create releases and, with a record UUID, redirect webhooks, unpublish documents, or overwrite user profiles.

item.title: CVE-2026-129943 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the updateSystem GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated administrators to execute shell commands via the package version string. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to the unvalidated version value, which is passed to child_process.exec() in yarn add or npm install commands, executing commands as the server process.

item.title: CVE-2026-129944 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the getIsPathValid function that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access sibling paths sharing a content directory name prefix. Attackers can send requests with a no-cors header to the blob, update, and tree handlers under /api/keystatic to read, create, overwrite, or delete files such as posts-evil/pwn.yaml.

item.title: CVE-2026-129945 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the githubOauthCallback handler that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to sign victims in with the attacker's GitHub account by omitting state validation. Attackers can induce victims to visit the OAuth callback with an attacker-obtained authorization code, causing victim edits in the admin UI to be committed under the attacker's GitHub identity.

item.title: CVE-2026-129946 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Keystatic through 0.6.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DocumentRenderer component that allows authenticated content editors to inject scripts via unvalidated link href values. Editors can paste anchors with javascript: URLs into document fields, executing script when visitors click rendered links and stealing the keystatic-gh-access-token cookie.

item.title: CVE-2026-129947 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Contentlayer @contentlayer/core through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JavaScript by embedding single quotes in content file names. Attackers can add a content file whose name breaks out of the import specifier in makeDataExportFile(), executing injected code when contentlayer dev or a Next.js dev server imports the generated module.

item.title: CVE-2026-129948 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Contentlayer @contentlayer/source-files through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers who control content files to execute JavaScript by abusing gray-matter's still-enabled JavaScript engine in parseMarkdown(). Attackers can start a Markdown or MDX file with a ---js or ---javascript frontmatter delimiter to run code during build, exposing CI build secrets.

item.title: CVE-2026-129949 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Rowy through 3.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to inject unsanitized HTML into Markdown cells. Attackers can store iframe, object, or form elements with javascript: URLs that execute when administrators view the table, stealing Firebase sessions.

item.title: CVE-2026-129950 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Rowy through 3.0.0 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability in default Firebase Storage rules that grants any user holding a role read and write access to the entire bucket. Authenticated users restricted to a single table or read-only access can use the Firebase SDK directly to list, download, overwrite, and delete any stored files.

item.title: CVE-2026-129951 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Rowy through 3.0.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to inject scripts via URL field links lacking scheme validation. Attackers can store values like javascript: URIs containing the string http in URL cells, executing script when victims click the open-link button to steal Firebase sessions.

item.title: CVE-2026-129952 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain administrator access by forging JWTs with the hardcoded 'nodepress-secret' fallback key. Attackers can sign HS256 bearer tokens with the default issuer, audience, and role 'admin' to access administrator-only APIs for article, comment, options, and file management.

item.title: CVE-2026-129953 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | NodePress through 8.5.1 contains a rate limit bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade throttling by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header, because trustProxy is enabled. Attackers can send X-Forwarded-For set to 127.0.0.1 or rotate values to brute-force the administrator password via POST /admin/login and evade comment IP blocklists.

item.title: CVE-2026-129954 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in linesToEmailContent() that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject markup into notification emails because comment content is not escaped. Attackers can post comments or replies via POST /comments containing forged links, images, or tracking resources rendered in administrator and author mail clients from the blog's address.

item.title: CVE-2026-129955 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | NodePress through 8.5.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain administrator access by using the hardcoded default password 'root'. Attackers can send base64-encoded 'root' to POST /admin/login when NP_ADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD is unset to obtain admin tokens and fully control the site.

item.title: CVE-2026-129956 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.5 | Sandboxie-Plus before 1.18.6 contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability in SbieSvc that allows standard users to launch UpdUtil.exe as SYSTEM via MSGID_PROCESS_RUN_UPDATER requests. Attackers can inject code into a signed SandMan.exe process to bypass the signature check and write attacker-controlled files to arbitrary paths, achieving SYSTEM code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-129957 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | PrestaShop before 8.2.9 and 9.0.0 before 9.2.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in back-office theme and module archive import that allows authenticated employees to write files outside intended directories. Attackers can craft a theme name in config/theme.yml or upload a module archive extracted before validation to place PHP files in web-accessible locations and execute code.

item.title: CVE-2026-3859 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.4
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.4 | XSS vulnerability in Vibe Versions <= 4.0.8.7 could allow an attacker to inject malicious JavaScript through crafted search input.

item.title: CVE-2026-3860 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Monday 16 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | CSRF vulnerability in OpenText Vibe versions <= 4.0.8.7 could expose the token over an insecure connection or make it accessible to JavaScript, weakening protection against forged requests.
